thread.subject: 401 Authorization Required after cluster token rotation

messages.body:
We rotated the CAST AI cluster token for our EKS cluster ngm-sim2-eks through the API.
About an hour later the cluster-controller started logging 401 Authorization Required and
the console says "Cluster controller not responding". Our four concrete questions:

401 after rotation — expected?
Old token validity — how long?
Which secrets to update and restart?
Org API key usable instead of the cluster token?

grounding: .kimchi/docs/reply-glejn-token-rotation.md + token-rotation-e2e-status.md: endpoint is POST /v1/kubernetes/external-clusters/{clusterId}/token; the old token stays valid (observed at least 60 minutes); the fix is to update EVERY secret that holds the token and restart every component; an organization API key is NOT a substitute for the cluster token.

replyMustInclude: not (a )?(substitute|replacement)|not recommend replacing|cannot be replaced|no substitute
